title: paspalum ciliiferum
intro: Paspalum ciliiferum, commonly known as Paspalum grass, is a species of grass in the family Poaceae. It is used in traditional medicine, particularly in Latin America, for its health benefits, which include treating digestive issues and promoting wound healing. The therapeutic actions of Paspalum ciliiferum are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other secondary metabolites, which exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. Research suggests that the bioactive constituents of Paspalum ciliiferum may also possess hepatoprotective and anti-diabetic activities, although more studies are needed to confirm these findings.
